title: TS7, Knip production, strict-boolean-expressions,
resolution: TS7 `tsc` already runs in the plain-TS templates through `@typescript/native`; Knip production mode moved to TODO.md (needs `!` entries); `strict-boolean-expressions` gave 59 reports in 1388 files, none a bug (each treats `''` as absent on purpose), so it stays off; a Vitest related hook is not added, since T4 measured no token saving from faster gates; the bundling recipe is in `docs/standards/code-quality.md`.
